items.title: Claude Tag is Claude Code as a full team member in Slack
items.summary: Enterprise: Announced Tuesday, Claude Tag isn't just another channel to prompt — it's a persistent teammate with access to context across channels and the tools your team already uses. Tag it with a request and it breaks the task into stages, writes or merges pull requests, runs data analysis, or helps resolve incidents in-thread.
